title.zh-TW: 未識別終端機也能用 Shift+Enter 換行
title.en: Shift+Enter can now insert newlines in unidentified terminals

body.zh-TW:
在終端機撰寫多行提示詞時，輸入過程往往習慣按住 Shift 鍵加上 Enter 換行。如果目前使用的終端機未被工具自動識別，以前按這組按鍵常常無法順利插入換行。

⟦跟飯店櫃檯調整接待方式一樣，以前門僮沒看見熟悉的護照封面就只會講單句英文，現在改好接待安排，遇到陌生封面也能流暢長談。⟧

現在只要在設定檔的 `[ui]` 區塊加入以下設定：

```toml
[ui]
kitty_keyboard = "query"
```

將選項設為 `query` 之後，即便終端機屬於未識別型號，按 Shift+Enter 也能正常插入換行字元。
body.en:
When writing multi-line prompts in a terminal, people often press and hold Shift along with Enter to insert newlines. If the current terminal is not automatically recognized by the tool, pressing this key combination previously often failed to insert newlines smoothly.

⟦A hotel front desk adjusts its reception workflow: previously, if the doorman did not see a familiar passport cover, they would speak only in single English sentences, but after updating the arrangements, they can converse smoothly at length even with unfamiliar covers.⟧

Now, you only need to add the following setting under the `[ui]` section of your configuration file:

```toml
[ui]
kitty_keyboard = "query"
```

After setting the option to `query`, pressing Shift+Enter inserts newline characters normally, even if the terminal is an unidentified model.

items.original: `[ui] kitty_keyboard = "query"` lets Shift+Enter insert newlines in unidentified terminals

title.zh-TW: MCP 伺服器連線不再於工作階段重新載入或更新時無故重啟
title.en: MCP server connections no longer restart unnecessarily on session reloads or updates

body.zh-TW:
藉由 MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）擴充能力時，你可能會在同一個工作階段中連續處理多項工作。以前在工作階段重新載入或更新時，伺服器連線會跟著無故重啟。

⟦彷彿與外聘顧問保持電話會議，以前每當你更換手邊的討論議程，通話都會無故斷線重撥；現在換議程時，不會再無故斷線重撥。⟧

連線機制調整後，工作階段在重新載入或更新時，不會再莫名重啟既有的伺服器連線。
body.en:
When expanding capabilities through MCP (Model Context Protocol, a protocol that connects AI to external tools), you might handle multiple tasks consecutively within the same session. Previously, server connections would restart unnecessarily whenever a session was reloaded or updated.

⟦Much like keeping an ongoing conference call with an external consultant, previously whenever you switched the discussion agenda at hand, the call would hang up and redial without cause; now when switching agendas, it will no longer disconnect and redial unnecessarily.⟧

Following adjustments to the connection mechanism, existing server connections no longer restart unnecessarily when a session is reloaded or updated.

items.original: MCP server connections no longer restart unnecessarily on session reloads or updates

title.zh-TW: 修正介面多處互動細節，複製與畫面狀態更一致
title.en: Multiple interface interaction details fixed, making copying and screen states more consistent

body.zh-TW:
日常在終端機操作與翻閱紀錄時，游標點擊與畫面資訊的同步表現直接影響使用手感。

引述複製功能現在會完整保留連結中的 `&` 符號；在未選中文字的空白處連按兩下，也不會再誤將思考區塊折疊起來。

快捷鍵 `Ctrl+L` 現在可在更多畫面上使用，且畫面上的複製提示文字，也與實際複製到剪貼簿的內容保持相符。

在執行倒轉操作後，頁尾顯示的上下文用量不再會降為零或顯示過期數值。

在 `/resume` 清單中查看歷史項目時，每一列內容的展開與折疊方式，現在與工作階段內部完全一致。

以前在倒轉後容易看見用量數值失準，或複製連結時遺失特定符號，現在這些介面問題都已經修好。
body.en:
During everyday terminal operations and when browsing history, cursor clicks and the synchronization of screen information directly affect the overall feel.

Quote copy now fully preserves the `&` symbol in links, and double-clicking on empty space with no text selected no longer mistakenly folds thoughts.

The `Ctrl+L` shortcut now works on more screens, and copy hints on screen match what actually copies to the clipboard.

After performing a rewind, context usage shown in the footer no longer drops to zero or displays stale values.

When viewing history items in the `/resume` list, the way each row expands and collapses is now completely consistent with how it behaves inside a session.

Previously, usage values could easily become inaccurate after a rewind, or specific symbols could be lost when copying links; these interface issues have now all been fixed.

title.zh-TW: `Ctrl+L` 清除終端機畫面，重繪過程不再閃爍
title.en: `Ctrl+L` redraws the screen after a terminal clear without flashing

body.zh-TW: 當你在終端機使用 Grok Build 密集執行任務時，畫面上經常會累積長篇輸出內容。這時按下快速鍵 `Ctrl+L` 能清除終端機畫面並重新繪製工作介面，但以前重繪瞬間常會伴隨畫面閃爍。⟦像把寫滿筆記的白板整面擦淨，以前擦拭瞬間板面總會劇烈晃動並反光刺眼，現在板擦推過時表面平順翻新，文字與游標立刻穩定就位。⟧現在按下 `Ctrl+L` 清除終端機後重繪畫面，過程不會再發生閃爍。當你再次整理螢幕視野，終端機能直接平順呈現最新狀態。無論你是在編寫專案還是排查錯誤，頻繁清理畫面都不會再受到畫面抖動的干擾。
body.en: When you run intensive tasks with Grok Build in the terminal, lengthy output often accumulates on the screen. Pressing the `Ctrl+L` shortcut clears the terminal screen and redraws the working interface, but the redrawing moment previously came with screen flashing. ⟦Picture wiping down a whiteboard covered in notes. Erasing it previously caused the board to wobble violently with a blinding glare, but now the eraser glides across smoothly while text and the cursor settle steadily into place.⟧ Now, redrawing the screen after pressing `Ctrl+L` to clear the terminal no longer flashes. When you tidy up your display, the terminal smoothly presents the latest state directly. Whether you are coding a project or troubleshooting errors, frequent screen clearing will no longer be interrupted by screen jitter.

items.original: `Ctrl+L` redraws the screen after a terminal clear without flashing

title.zh-TW: Shell 指令正確處理含有特殊字元的啟動函式
title.en: Shell commands correctly handle startup functions containing special characters

body.zh-TW: 許多人在配置終端機環境時，習慣在設定檔中預先定義啟動函式，方便隨時呼叫常用流程。⟦跟物流倉儲的分揀機一樣，以前讀取貼有特殊符號的包裹常會直接卡關停擺，現在感應裝置能正確辨認每個特殊字元，貨物都能順暢送進對應通道。⟧現在 Shell（用來解讀與執行指令的環境）指令已能正確處理含有特殊字元的啟動函式。即使你的個人環境設定包含符號或特殊命名的啟動函式，執行各項指令時也能正常運作。
body.en: When configuring a terminal environment, many people routinely define startup functions in configuration files to easily invoke common workflows at any time. ⟦Just like a parcel sorter in a warehouse, scanning packages labeled with special symbols previously ground operations to a halt, but sensors now accurately recognize every special character so shipments glide smoothly into their assigned chutes.⟧ Shell (the environment that interprets and executes commands) commands now correctly handle startup functions that contain special characters. Even if your personal configuration includes startup functions with symbols or special names, running various commands will work properly.

items.original: Shell commands correctly handle startup functions containing special characters

title.zh-TW: 專案掛鉤與技能設定各自獨立，權限檔解析失敗跳警告
title.en: Project hooks and skill settings operate independently, with warnings when permission files fail to parse

body.zh-TW: 在多個儲存庫之間切換開發時，手動調整的設定若無聲無息失效，往往會引發意想不到的混亂。如果權限規則無法載入，例如語法解析錯誤或 `.claude/settings.json` 不是合法的 JSON 格式，現在開啟工作階段時會立刻跳出警告通知，不再默默略過。在 `/hooks` 停用某個專案的掛鉤（hook，特定事件發生時觸發的小程式）時，修改範圍僅限於當前儲存庫，不會連帶停用其他專案裡的同名掛鉤。在 Skills 分頁開關個別技能時，只會將 `[skills].disabled` 項目儲存至 `config.toml`，由組織統一派送的技能資料夾與忽略清單會持續維持套用。以前規則寫錯常讓人摸不著頭緒，停用專案工具還會意外波及其他工作區；現在問題即時提醒，各專案的外掛設定也互不干擾。
body.en: When switching development across multiple repositories, manual settings that fail silently often cause unexpected confusion. If permission rules fail to load, such as when syntax does not parse or `.claude/settings.json` is not valid JSON, a warning notification now appears immediately when opening a session instead of being silently skipped. Disabling a project hook in `/hooks` applies only to the current repository, without disabling hooks (small programs triggered by specific events) of the same name in other repositories. Turning an individual skill on or off in the Skills tab saves only `[skills].disabled` to `config.toml`, so managed skill folders and ignore lists distributed by an organization keep applying. Previously, misconfigured rules were baffling and disabling a project tool could inadvertently affect other workspaces; now issues surface immediately and plugin settings for each project remain isolated.

Permission rules that do not load, such as a rule that does not parse or a `.claude/settings.json` that is not valid JSON, show a warning when a session opens instead of being skipped silently
Disabling a project's hook in `/hooks` applies only to that repository, instead of also skipping hooks with the same name in other repositories
Turning a skill on or off in the Skills tab saves only `[skills].disabled` to `config.toml`, so an organization's managed skill folders and ignore list keep applying

title.zh-TW: 儀表板掌握背景代理動態，隨時中斷任務且按鈕支援懸停高亮
title.en: Dashboard tracks background agents, stops runs anytime, and highlights controls on hover

body.zh-TW: 指派背景代理同時處理多項任務時，能即時掌握真實進度並隨時喊停至關重要。⟦宛如操作中央監控台的調度員，螢幕上只會標明真正運轉中的機具數量，按下急停開關也能瞬間切斷作業，不必等巡檢單確認完畢。⟧工作流程狀態列現在會明確顯示「仍有多少代理正在執行」，而不是列出代理的建立總數。當背景任務跳出等待授權的確認卡片時，只要點擊工作列（dock，停靠在畫面邊緣的操作列）上的停止按鈕，就能立刻中止該背景執行，不必先被迫回答卡片。若工作階段仍有背景子代理或工作流程在跑，儀表板的清單項目會持續停留在「工作中」狀態，在此處停止該列也能徹底結束所有關聯任務。提問卡片的確認送出按鈕、儀表板彈出視窗的關閉鍵與摺疊的工作流程列，在滑鼠游標移過時也都會高亮醒目顯示。
body.en: When assigning background agents to handle multiple tasks at once, tracking real progress in real time and being able to halt runs at any moment is essential. ⟦Picture a dispatcher at a central monitoring console: the screens display only equipment actively running, and hitting an emergency stop cuts operations instantly without waiting to clear inspection slips.⟧ Workflow status lines now clearly say how many agents are still running instead of listing the total number created. When an approval card pops up for a background task, clicking the stop button in the dock (an action bar pinned along the screen edge) stops that background run immediately instead of forcing you to answer the card first. Dashboard rows stay in Working while a session has background subagents or workflow runs going, and stopping the row there completely ends all related tasks. A question card's `Enter:submit` button, the dashboard session popup's `[✗]`, and collapsed workflow rows also highlight prominently when hovered by the mouse pointer.

title.zh-TW: 拒絕變更保留手動存檔，不再覆寫你自己修改的內容
title.en: Rejecting changes preserves manual saves, preventing your own edits from being overwritten

body.zh-TW: 趁著模型產生程式碼的空檔順手修補檔案，最擔心的就是退回建議時自己的心血被一併沖掉。⟦恰似請裝潢師傅在設計圖紙上標記草案，就算你最後否決了他的整套改建構想，你自己先前用色筆畫上的插座標記依然完整保留。⟧以前若 Grok 漏偵測到你手動存檔，拒絕變更時就會覆寫你已儲存的修改。現在即使 Grok 漏偵測到存檔事件，當你選擇拒絕變更時，檔案中所有由你親自儲存的修改都會被完整保留下來。
body.en: Tinkering with files while waiting for a model to generate code comes with the worry that rejecting a suggestion will wipe away your own work. ⟦Think of asking a contractor to sketch proposals onto a blueprint: even if you reject the remodeling concept altogether, the outlet marks you penciled in beforehand remain intact.⟧ Previously, if Grok missed detecting a manual save, rejecting a change would overwrite the edits you had already stored. Now, even when Grok misses a save event, choosing to reject a change keeps all edits you saved to the file yourself completely intact.

items.original: Rejecting a change keeps edits you saved to the file yourself, even when Grok missed the save, instead of overwriting them

title.zh-TW: 匯出至無程式讀取的具名管道立即報錯，背景寫入時刪除不再報「Directory not empty」
title.en: Exporting to unread named pipes fails immediately, and deleting sessions during background writes avoids "Directory not empty"

body.zh-TW: 跨目錄恢復歷史工作階段或將對話匯出到管線，以往常因資料夾路徑與背景寫入而受阻。⟦跟翻閱隨身索引夾一樣，無論你在哪一個工作桌前翻開標籤，都能直接指引回當初存放卷宗的特定抽屜。⟧現在無論你從哪一個目錄啟動終端機，執行 `grok --resume <id>` 都會自動切換至當初記錄該工作階段（session，工作期間的對話與狀態紀錄）的資料夾開啟，不再直接報錯拒絕。當使用 `/export` 將對話匯出至沒有任何程式正在讀取的具名管道（讓程式經由特定路徑傳送資料的通道）時，Grok 會立即回報失敗，不再凍結到只能強制終止行程。執行 `grok sessions delete` 清理歷史紀錄時，即使其他背景行程仍在向該工作階段資料夾寫入資料，也不會再因「Directory not empty」錯誤而中斷。
body.en: Resuming past sessions across directories or piping conversations outward was often blocked by folder paths and background writes. ⟦Much like flipping through a portable index binder, opening a tab from any desk leads straight back to the specific drawer where the dossier was originally filed.⟧ Now, wherever you launch your terminal from, running `grok --resume <id>` automatically switches to open in the folder where the session (records of conversation and state during work) was recorded, instead of refusing outright. When using `/export` to send a conversation to a named pipe (a channel that passes data between programs via a file path) that nothing is reading, Grok fails right away instead of freezing until killed. When cleaning up history with `grok sessions delete`, it no longer fails with "Directory not empty" even while other background processes are still writing into that session folder.

items.original:
`grok --resume <id>` opens the session in the folder it was recorded in, wherever you launch Grok from, instead of refusing
`/export` to a named pipe that nothing is reading fails right away instead of freezing Grok until it is killed
`grok sessions delete` no longer fails with "Directory not empty" when another process is still writing into the session's folder

title.zh-TW: 提示詞支援首尾跳轉與選取，捲動歷史鍵入字元自動聚焦
title.en: Prompts support boundary jumps and selection, while typing in scrollback auto-focuses

body.zh-TW: 編輯長篇提示詞或翻閱歷史訊息時，頻繁切換游標與輸入焦點往往打斷思路。現在按 `Cmd+Up`/`Cmd+Down` 或 `Ctrl+Home`/`Ctrl+End` 可直達提示詞首尾，加按 `Shift` 能從目前游標選到提示詞開頭或結尾。在空白提示詞按 `Left` 鍵，從任何工作階段或歡迎畫面都能開啟儀表板。捲動歷史中按 `Ctrl+L` 可將選取的整則訊息或反白文字轉成引文填入提示詞，擴充套件改以 `/plugins` 開啟。捲動歷史取得焦點且未開啟 vim 鍵（用字母鍵移動與編輯文字的模式）時，鍵入數字或符號現在會跟字母一樣，移回提示詞並輸入；`?` 仍開啟指令區。當 `Ctrl+Enter` 被接收成一般 `Enter` 時，頁尾送出提示會顯示 `Enter Enter`，預設設定的 tmux（終端機分割工具）就是例子。
body.en: When editing lengthy prompts or reviewing message history, constantly switching cursor and input focus often interrupts your train of thought. Pressing `Cmd+Up`/`Cmd+Down` or `Ctrl+Home`/`Ctrl+End` now jumps directly to the start or end of the prompt, and adding `Shift` selects from the current cursor to the prompt start or end. Pressing `Left` on an empty prompt opens the dashboard from any session or welcome screen. In scrollback, pressing `Ctrl+L` adds a selected message or highlighted text to the prompt as a quote, while extensions now open via `/plugins` instead. Typing a digit or symbol while scrollback has focus, with vim keys (a mode using letter keys for navigation and editing) turned off, moves focus to the prompt and types it there, just as letters already do; `?` still opens the command palette. When `Ctrl+Enter` arrives as plain `Enter`, the footer send indicator displays `Enter Enter`, with tmux (a terminal multiplexer) under default settings being one example.

title.zh-TW: 狹小終端機介面自適應精簡，特殊字元與舊版主控台不再破圖
title.en: Compact terminals adaptively streamline UI, while special characters and legacy consoles display cleanly

body.zh-TW: 將視窗縮小或在舊版主控台操作時，擠成一團的文字與缺字方框往往讓人難以閱讀。在狹窄畫面中，頁尾與狀態列會自動精簡項目，防止按鈕重疊或被截斷。在高度不足的終端機開啟倒回（rewind，將對話復原至先前步驟）確認視窗，或在該確認視窗開著時縮小終端機，Grok 不再當機。emoji（表情符號）與按鍵符號精確依終端機實際寬度計算，列不再超出框線，也不再遺失列尾的 `…`。生成媒體路徑包含中日文字元或 Windows 格式時，檔名也能完整保留並貼合欄寬。在 Windows 舊版主控台（如 cmd.exe 與 PowerShell），清單列的符號改用相容字元，不再出現破圖空方框。16 色終端機則將貼上標籤與工具強調色改為其他次要文字使用的柔和灰，淺色主題下貼上標籤的括號也不再消失。
body.en: Shrinking windows or operating in legacy consoles often makes crowded text and missing character glyphs painful to read. In narrow screens, footer and status bars automatically drop or shorten items, preventing buttons from overlapping or being cut off. Opening a rewind (restoring a conversation to an earlier step) confirmation dialog on a short terminal, or shrinking the terminal while that window remains open, no longer crashes Grok. Emoji and keycap symbols are measured precisely to the terminal's actual rendering width, so rows no longer overflow their borders or lose their trailing `…`. When generated media paths contain Chinese or Japanese characters or Windows formats, file names remain intact and fit row widths. On older Windows consoles such as `cmd.exe` and PowerShell, symbols in list rows use compatible characters instead of rendering as broken empty boxes. Terminals with 16 colors display paste labels and tool accents in the muted gray used by other secondary text, and paste label brackets no longer vanish under the light theme.

items.original:
Windows: on older consoles such as plain `cmd.exe` and Windows PowerShell windows, the `▶`, `⏸` and `◌` marks in todo, workflow and list rows show as characters the console can draw instead of empty boxes
Generated image and video paths with wide characters such as Chinese, Japanese or emoji fit their row and keep the file name, and Windows paths keep it too
The rewind confirmation no longer crashes Grok on a short terminal or when you shrink the window while it is open
Footer and status bars in narrow terminals drop or shorten the items that do not fit, instead of painting them over each other or cutting buttons off
16-color terminals show the paste label and tool accents in the muted gray other secondary text uses, and the paste label brackets no longer vanish on the light theme
Emoji and keycap symbols are measured at the width the terminal draws them, so rows no longer run past their box or lose their `…`

title.zh-TW: 工具輸出截斷對齊程式碼規格，引文排版與排隊筆記顯示更完整
title.en: Tool output truncation aligns with code cells, while quote layout and queued notes display fully

body.zh-TW: 閱讀引文對話或檢查工具回傳的長文字時，清楚規整的排版能幫你迅速掌握關鍵細節。當 Fetch、網路搜尋或 MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）的輸出過長被截斷時，底部會顯示如同程式碼單元的提示列，標明剩餘行數與展開按鍵。只隱藏一行時會顯示 `+1 line`。在排隊提示詞上方顯示的模型切換結果或就緒工作樹（worktree，讓專案平行開副本的功能），當提示詞開始執行時會持續保留在螢幕上，不再被捲出視野。在對話引文方面，引文內的程式碼區塊每一行都會整齊收在引用線下方，複製引文時參照連結會自動轉為行內連結，多行數學公式後的行號也標記正確。若點擊了當前環境無法開啟的連結或本機檔案，例如在無桌面畫面的遠端連線下，介面會明確顯示原因，不再毫無動靜。
body.en: Clear and disciplined formatting helps you quickly grasp key details when reading quoted dialogue or inspecting lengthy tool output. When output from Fetch, Web Search, or MCP (a protocol connecting AI to external tools) is cut off, the bottom displays an indicator row matching code cells to show remaining lines and your viewer key. A single hidden line reads `+1 line`. Notes above a queued prompt showing a model switch result or a ready worktree (a feature enabling parallel working copies for a project) stay on screen when execution starts, instead of scrolling out of view. Inside conversation quotes, every line of a code block stays neatly beneath the quote bars, copying a quote turns reference links into inline links, and lines following multi-line math are numbered correctly. Clicking a link or local file that cannot open in the current environment, such as over an SSH connection with no display, clearly explains why instead of doing nothing.

items.original:
Clicking a link or file that cannot open, such as over SSH with no display, shows why, for example "Can't open links over SSH"
Notes above a queued prompt, such as a model switch result or a ready worktree, stay on screen when the prompt starts instead of scrolling out of view
Cut-off Fetch, Web Search and MCP tool output ends with the same `… +N lines · <key> to view all` row as code cells, naming your viewer key, and one hidden line reads `+1 line`
Code blocks inside quotes render every line under the quote's bars, quote copies turn reference links into inline links, and lines after multi-line math are numbered correctly

entries: Messages between subagents appear as left-aligned rows under the bullet that name the sender and recipient, replacing the centered rows
Shift+Enter inserts a newline in VS Code and other xterm.js-based terminals that use the Kitty keyboard protocol
`/mcps`: when a browser cannot open an MCP server's sign-in URL, the URL shows in a panel you can copy with `c` or the `[copy the url]` button
Shell approval cards say when Auto-review blocked a command or could not review it, and `Ctrl+F` shows the reviewer's explanation
`!` mode Tab completion offers commands installed as symlinks, such as Homebrew, npm, rustup and Debian alternatives binaries
Quotes in replies get a `[Copy]` button that copies the whole quote as Markdown without its `>` markers
Named subagent links open on a plain click, so they work over SSH from macOS where a modified click cannot reach Grok
`@` paths outside the workspace: an `@` path that starts with `/`, `~/` or `../` lists files from that folder; set `[ui] at_picker_outside_workspace = false` to turn it off
Picked `@` files in the prompt can be edited in place: `Backspace` at the end of one reopens the picker on its path, and `Left` or `Right` puts the cursor inside it to change the path
Built-in skills, agents and workflows are refreshed when their local cache's manifest is missing or corrupt, instead of staying outdated or failing every sync
`Ctrl+Y` on a question card no longer closes it without an answer; while you type an answer, it pastes back text cut with `Ctrl+K`
`/new` tabs show the context window you just switched to before the new session replies
Resumed sessions show a background command's completion in the turn that ran it, with its real run time instead of about 0.0s
`grok update` still runs when `--sandbox` or config sets a sandbox profile, unless Grok is already running confined
A code block `[Copy]` in the transcript copies while a queued prompt is open for editing, instead of copying nothing or closing the edit
`grok logout` stays signed out when another running Grok refreshes its sign-in, instead of signing you back in on the next launch
Opening links and files from the TUI no longer leaves a zombie process behind for each click
A failed session delete shows the "Could not delete session" prefix once, so the reason is no longer cut off
Windows: Grok exits fully after a startup error, a `/minimal` or `/fullscreen` switch, or a signal, instead of sometimes hanging
Grok running confined in a sandbox never starts an update on its own and tells you to run `grok update` instead
Quitting to install an update with `Ctrl+U` on the welcome screen exits within the usual exit deadline instead of sometimes hanging after "Update installed"
`grok update --force-reinstall`, or `grok update --version` with the installed version, keeps your working `grok` on Linux and macOS when the download fails its checks, instead of deleting it

Windows installers check that the downloaded build runs before replacing `grok.exe` and `agent.exe`, and keep the existing install when it does not, such as when a proxy serves a blocked-download page
Command-line arguments that are not valid UTF-8 no longer crash `grok` at startup: paths such as `--cwd` accept them, and text such as `-p` gets a usage error
Installers keep the installed `grok` when a proxy or cache returns an empty download, instead of replacing it with an empty file and reporting success
Environment variables with non-UTF-8 bytes no longer stop Grok from starting
Workflow run lines in the transcript end with what the run returned instead of a bare colon, `/tasks` shows the time it was taken, and polling an unknown task id leaves a row with its error
Headless runs stopped by Ctrl-C or SIGTERM end their `json`, `streaming-json` or `streaming-messages-json` output with a closing record that keeps the run's outcome, instead of cutting off the stream
macOS: the TUI no longer freezes when it runs inside a sandbox that blocks the window server

`grok -p --resume` shows why a session could not load instead of always "Session does not exist", and with `--output-format json` a resume, continue or fork that fails before the session opens prints one JSON error

Sessions with an unrecognized reasoning effort or unreadable bytes in their history resume instead of failing: the session runs at the model's default effort and says so once, and the unreadable lines are left out of the transcript

Windows: on older consoles such as plain `cmd.exe` and Windows PowerShell windows, status marks and selection arrows in workflow views, the dashboard, and the feedback and extensions dialogs show as `>`, `•`, `√` or `x` instead of empty boxes
File paths with spaces in inline code, such as `~/Library/Application Support/...`, link to the whole path when it exists instead of stopping at the first space
Feedback that cannot be sent leads with the outcome, such as "Could not send feedback. Saved to Drafts.", then gives the reason and says to retry from `/feedback`
Dialog tab labels, shortcuts and settings rows that do not fit end in `…` instead of being cut off
Prompt history search highlights matched letters in the same color as other fuzzy lists, and the counts on the `/` and `@` menu borders are dimmed like other border captions
Dashboard: the peek header reads `Responding` while a reply streams, and the `Esc` footer hint reads `new agent` like the other lowercase hints
Custom agent files saved with a UTF-8 byte order mark, as some Windows editors write them, load instead of being skipped
Running markers in workflow views and MCP servers that are still starting use the theme's running color, like other progress indicators
Minimal mode: "Sign-in failed" shows in the error color instead of the warning color

A larger context window picked with `/context-window` stays in effect, so compaction no longer starts early after the session sits idle, after a failed request such as a rate limit, or until you restart
Long sessions use less memory: finished Markdown blocks far off screen release their rendered layout, and search still finds their text
Typing no longer lags when ffmpeg is not installed and `PATH` holds slow directories, such as Windows drives under WSL
Long pastes that arrive as keystrokes, such as pastes on native Windows or in terminals without bracketed paste, no longer freeze the prompt for seconds while the plan-mode tip is on
Pasting long single-line text such as logs, JSON or base64 into the prompt no longer freezes the TUI for seconds
File watching on Linux no longer keeps a CPU core busy for about a minute after startup in large repositories
Lower CPU use while subagents run: the TUI repaints only for animations on screen
`grok --resume <id>` opens much faster on large session stores, reading only the resumed session instead of every session

title.zh-TW: @ 檔案選擇器支援工作區外路徑與原地編輯
title.en: @ File Picker Supports Outside-Workspace Paths and In-Place Editing

body.zh-TW:
你在對話提示框輸入 `@` 挑選檔案時，經常需要引用專案資料夾以外的設定檔或參考資料。⟦宛如在通訊錄搜尋聯絡人，以前只能挑選同部門成員且點選後無法更動，現在不僅能跨部門翻找名冊，選取後還能隨時退格重選。⟧現在只要在 `@` 後方輸入 `/`、`~/` 或 `../` 開頭的路徑，選單就會直接列出該目錄下的檔案清單。如果不需要這項行為，可以在設定中加入：

```toml
[ui]
at_picker_outside_workspace = false
```

已經挑選進提示框的 `@` 檔案也能直接在原地修改。在標記結尾按下 `Backspace`，選單會沿著原本路徑再次展開；按下鍵盤的 `Left` 或 `Right` 方向鍵，則能把游標移入路徑文字之中直接編輯。
body.en:
When picking files with `@` in the prompt, you often need to reference configuration files or documentation outside the project folder. ⟦Browsing contacts in an address book once meant being restricted to your own department without any way to alter selections, but you can now search across departments and backspace to choose again at any time.⟧ Now, typing a path starting with `/`, `~/` or `../` after `@` lists files directly from that directory. If you do not need this behavior, add the following to your configuration:

```toml
[ui]
at_picker_outside_workspace = false
```

Picked `@` files in the prompt can also be edited directly in place. Pressing `Backspace` at the end of a token reopens the picker on its original path; pressing `Left` or `Right` arrow keys places the cursor inside the path text for direct editing.

items.original:
`@` paths outside the workspace: an `@` path that starts with `/`, `~/` or `../` lists files from that folder; set `[ui] at_picker_outside_workspace = false` to turn it off
Picked `@` files in the prompt can be edited in place: `Backspace` at the end of one reopens the picker on its path, and `Left` or `Right` puts the cursor inside it to change the path

title.zh-TW: 終端輸入支援換行與捷徑補齊，審查卡片提供攔截說明
title.en: Terminal Input Supports Newlines and Symlink Completion, with Explanations on Approval Cards

body.zh-TW:
在終端機輸入提示詞與處理互動卡片時，各項按鍵行為現在更符合操作預期。在 VS Code 或其他採用 Kitty 鍵盤協定的 xterm.js 終端機中，按下 `Shift+Enter` 現在會正常插入換行符號。

使用 `!` 模式輸入外部指令時，按下 Tab 鍵補齊功能現在會列出透過符號連結（symlink，指向另一個位置的捷徑檔）安裝的指令，例如 Homebrew、npm、rustup 與 Debian alternatives 的二進位執行檔。

當介面跳出指令審查卡片時，若自動審查攔截了指令或無法審查，卡片會清楚標註狀態，按下 `Ctrl+F` 還能查看審查者的詳細說明。

面對提問卡片時，按下 `Ctrl+Y` 不再於尚未回答時關閉卡片；輸入答案時，它會貼回先前用 `Ctrl+K` 剪下的文字。
body.en:
Key behavior now aligns more closely with expectations when typing prompts and interacting with cards in the terminal. In VS Code and other xterm.js-based terminals using the Kitty keyboard protocol, pressing `Shift+Enter` now properly inserts a newline.

In `!` mode, Tab completion now lists commands installed as symlinks (shortcut files pointing to another location), such as Homebrew, npm, rustup, and Debian alternatives binaries.

When a shell approval card pops up, the card clearly displays status when Auto-review blocked a command or could not review it, and pressing `Ctrl+F` shows the reviewer's detailed explanation.

On question cards, pressing `Ctrl+Y` no longer closes the card without an answer. While typing an answer, it pastes back text previously cut with `Ctrl+K`.

items.original:
Shift+Enter inserts a newline in VS Code and other xterm.js-based terminals that use the Kitty keyboard protocol
Shell approval cards say when Auto-review blocked a command or could not review it, and `Ctrl+F` shows the reviewer's explanation
`!` mode Tab completion offers commands installed as symlinks, such as Homebrew, npm, rustup and Debian alternatives binaries
`Ctrl+Y` on a question card no longer closes it without an answer; while you type an answer, it pastes back text cut with `Ctrl+K`

title.zh-TW: 回覆引用支援乾淨複製，補齊程式碼與登入網址面板
title.en: Clean Copying for Reply Quotes, Reliable Code Copying, and a Sign-In URL Panel

body.zh-TW:
整理對話紀錄中的程式碼與文字引用時，複製內容的操作變得更加順手。⟦好比在閱覽室整理摘錄，以前遇到無效連結或正在動筆時摘錄夾常會卡死，現在隨時都能把乾淨引文收進筆記。⟧回覆中的引用文字新增 `[Copy]` 按鈕，點擊後能直接複製為不帶 `>` 標記的 Markdown 格式。

當下方開著排隊中的提示詞準備編輯時，點擊紀錄裡的程式碼 `[Copy]` 會確實複製，不再出現複製無效或意外關閉編輯框的情況。

輸入 `/mcps` 時，若瀏覽器無法自動開啟 MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）伺服器的登入網址，面板會直接顯示網址，方便按 `c` 或 `[copy the url]` 複製。
body.en:
Copying content is now much smoother when managing code and quotations in the transcript. ⟦Like sorting excerpts in a reading room, where clippings previously froze whenever you hit an invalid reference or started writing, clean quotations can now be collected into your notes at any time.⟧ Quotations in replies gain a `[Copy]` button that copies the text directly as Markdown without its `>` markers.

Clicking `[Copy]` on a code block in the transcript copies reliably while a queued prompt is open for editing, rather than failing to copy or unexpectedly closing the editor.

When running `/mcps`, if the browser cannot automatically open an MCP (Model Context Protocol, a protocol for connecting AI to external tools) server's sign-in URL, the panel displays the URL directly so you can copy it with `c` or `[copy the url]`.

items.original:
`/mcps`: when a browser cannot open an MCP server's sign-in URL, the URL shows in a panel you can copy with `c` or the `[copy the url]` button
Quotes in replies get a `[Copy]` button that copies the whole quote as Markdown without its `>` markers
A code block `[Copy]` in the transcript copies while a queued prompt is open for editing, instead of copying nothing or closing the edit

title.zh-TW: 支援普通點擊跳轉子代理，空格路徑完整連結不截斷
title.en: Plain Clicks Open Subagents, and Spaced Paths Form Complete Links Without Truncation

body.zh-TW:
在終端介面點選檔案路徑與代理連結時，跳轉與開啟機制變得更穩定。⟦恰似整修社區告示牌上的跳轉指引，以前按壓特殊開關常無反應，點開附件還會殘留廢棄底片；現在普通點選就能直通完整目標，也不再留下任何多餘行程。⟧具名子代理的連結現在只要普通點擊即可開啟。當你從 macOS 透過 SSH 連線操作，複合點擊訊號無法順利傳遞給 Grok 時，依然能順利點開子代理畫面。

從終端介面開啟連結與檔案時，修復了每次點擊都會在背景殘留殭屍行程的問題。

行內程式碼若包含帶空格的路徑，例如 `~/Library/Application Support/...`，只要檔案存在就會將整串路徑建為連結，不再於第一個空格處中斷。
body.en:
Navigation and opening mechanisms are more reliable when clicking file paths and agent links in the terminal interface. ⟦A renovated community noticeboard guides navigation smoothly: while pressing special switches once failed to respond and opening attachments left discarded films behind, a standard click now reaches the full target without lingering processes.⟧ Links to named subagents now open on a plain click. Even when connecting from macOS over SSH where modified clicks fail to reach Grok, you can still open subagent views smoothly.

Opening links and files from the terminal interface fixes an issue where every click left behind a zombie process in the background.

When inline code contains paths with spaces, such as `~/Library/Application Support/...`, the entire string links to the destination as long as the file exists, instead of truncating at the first space.

items.original:
Named subagent links open on a plain click, so they work over SSH from macOS where a modified click cannot reach Grok
Opening links and files from the TUI no longer leaves a zombie process behind for each click
File paths with spaces in inline code, such as `~/Library/Application Support/...`, link to the whole path when it exists instead of stopping at the first space

title.zh-TW: 子代理訊息改為靠左條列，快取損壞自動修復並補齊流程紀錄
title.en: Subagent Messages Left-Aligned, Corrupt Caches Auto-Repaired, and Workflow Logs Completed

body.zh-TW:
追蹤背景任務、工作流程與多個代理之間的協作時，排版與除錯資訊更為完整。子代理之間的對話訊息改為靠左條列顯示在標註發送者與接收者的項目符號下方，取代了過往置中排列的版面。

當內建技能、代理或工作流程在本機的快取（cache，把算過／查過的結果暫存起來直接用）清單遺失或損壞時，Grok 會主動重新整理，不再持續保留過期內容或導致每次同步都失敗。

對話紀錄裡的工作流程執行紀錄，結尾現在會直接顯示回傳的執行成果，不再只有單獨一個冒號。輸入 `/tasks` 時會清楚顯示任務執行的具體時間；若查詢未知的任務 ID，清單也會保留該列並標示錯誤訊息。
body.en:
Layout and debugging information are more comprehensive when tracking background tasks, workflows, and multi-agent collaboration. Messages between subagents now appear as left-aligned rows beneath the bullet marking the sender and recipient, replacing the previous centered layout.

When the local cache (temporary storage for computed or fetched results) manifest for built-in skills, agents, or workflows is missing or corrupt, Grok refreshes it automatically instead of staying outdated or failing every sync.

Workflow run lines in the transcript now end with the returned result rather than a bare colon. Entering `/tasks` clearly displays the specific time the task ran. Querying an unknown task ID keeps the row in place with its error message.

items.original:
Messages between subagents appear as left-aligned rows under the bullet that name the sender and recipient, replacing the centered rows
Built-in skills, agents and workflows are refreshed when their local cache's manifest is missing or corrupt, instead of staying outdated or failing every sync
Workflow run lines in the transcript end with what the run returned instead of a bare colon, `/tasks` shows the time it was taken, and polling an unknown task id leaves a row with its error

title.zh-TW: 恢復對話僅讀取指定紀錄，修復耗時顯示與損毀容錯
title.en: Resuming Sessions Reads Only Target Records, Fixing Duration Display and Corruption Handling

body.zh-TW:
重新載入過往對話時，舊紀錄的容錯能力與讀取速度皆有改善。⟦跟從存檔庫調閱歷史卷宗一樣，以前遇到破損頁面就整份報廢，翻找時還得整庫清點；現在直取目標檔案，部分墨跡模糊也能正常翻開。⟧執行 `grok --resume <id>` 時只讀取指定紀錄，不再掃描整個儲存庫，開啟速度加快。

恢復對話後，背景指令的完成狀態會標在原輪次中，並顯示實際執行時間，不再出現約 0.0s。

歷史紀錄若含未知的推論強度或損壞位元組，工作階段會以預設強度運作並提示一次，並排除損毀行。

使用 `grok -p --resume` 載入失敗會顯示具體原因而非固定報錯；加上 `--output-format json` 時，開啟前失敗會印出單一 JSON 錯誤。
body.en:
Tolerance for legacy transcripts and loading performance are both improved when reloading previous conversations. ⟦Just as pulling historical files from an archive once meant auditing every shelf and discarding entire folders over a torn page, you can now retrieve the target file directly even if parts of the ink are damaged.⟧ Running `grok --resume <id>` reads only the specified session instead of scanning the entire store, opening much faster.

After resuming a session, background command completion is recorded in the turn that ran it, showing the actual execution time rather than about 0.0s.

Sessions whose history contains an unrecognized reasoning effort or unreadable bytes run at the model's default effort with a single notice, leaving corrupted lines out of the transcript.

When loading fails under `grok -p --resume`, the interface displays the specific reason instead of a fixed error message. With `--output-format json`, failures before opening print a single JSON error.

items.original:
Resumed sessions show a background command's completion in the turn that ran it, with its real run time instead of about 0.0s
`grok -p --resume` shows why a session could not load instead of always "Session does not exist", and with `--output-format json` a resume, continue or fork that fails before the session opens prints one JSON error
Sessions with an unrecognized reasoning effort or unreadable bytes in their history resume instead of failing: the session runs at the model's default effort and says so once, and the unreadable lines are left out of the transcript
`grok --resume <id>` opens much faster on large session stores, reading only the resumed session instead of every session

title.zh-TW: 上下文視窗容量持續鎖定，分頁即時顯示並修復登出狀態
title.en: Context Window Capacity Remains Locked, Tabs Update Instantly, and Logout Persistence Fixed

body.zh-TW:
切換對話分頁與調整模型容量時，各項工作階段的狀態維持皆有加強。透過 `/context-window` 挑選較大的上下文視窗後，該設定現在會持續鎖定生效。即便對話長時間閒置、遇到請求限流等錯誤，在主動重啟之前都不會提早觸發內容壓縮。

使用 `/new` 開啟新分頁時，介面在新對話回覆前就會立刻顯示剛切換過去的上下文視窗大小。

執行 `grok logout` 登出後，即使背景有另一個 Grok 實體正在更新登入憑據，也不會在下次啟動時被自動重新登入，確保登出狀態持久有效。

如果刪除工作階段失敗，介面只會印出一次「Could not delete session」前綴提示，讓後續的具體錯誤原因能完整呈現，不再遭到切除。
body.en:
State persistence across sessions is strengthened when switching conversation tabs and adjusting model capacity. After selecting a larger context window via `/context-window`, that setting remains locked in effect. Even if a session sits idle for an extended period or encounters errors like rate limits, compaction will not trigger early before you restart.

Opening a new tab with `/new` immediately displays the context window size you just switched to before the new conversation replies.

After running `grok logout`, you will not be signed back in automatically on the next launch even if another running Grok instance refreshes credentials in the background, ensuring sign-out persists.

If deleting a session fails, the interface prints the "Could not delete session" prefix only once, allowing the specific failure reason to display fully without truncation.

items.original:
`/new` tabs show the context window you just switched to before the new session replies
`grok logout` stays signed out when another running Grok refreshes its sign-in, instead of signing you back in on the next launch
A failed session delete shows the "Could not delete session" prefix once, so the reason is no longer cut off
A larger context window picked with `/context-window` stays in effect, so compaction no longer starts early after the session sits idle, after a failed request such as a rate limit, or until you restart

title.zh-TW: 更新下載檢驗失敗保留原檔，加固沙盒防護與退出流程
title.en: Update Download Verification Failures Retain Original Binaries, Hardening Sandbox and Exit Flows

body.zh-TW:
升級版本或在隔離環境維護時，安裝與更新流程有了更健全的防護。⟦就像為大樓更新門禁，以前送來空包裹或檢驗失敗時舊閘門會直接被拆除，現在必須確認新零件無誤才允許替換。⟧在 Linux 與 macOS 執行 `grok update --force-reinstall` 或指定現有版本時，若下載未通過檢查會保留既有執行檔，不再直接刪除。

若代理伺服器或快取（cache，把算過／查過的結果暫存起來直接用）傳回空檔，安裝程式會保留原本檔案，不再誤報成功。

在歡迎畫面按 `Ctrl+U` 結束安裝時，會在正常時限內退出，不再於顯示「Update installed」後卡死。

透過設定或 `--sandbox` 指定沙盒時，未受限狀態下仍可跑 `grok update`；處於隔離沙盒時則不再自動更新，改為提示手動執行。
body.en:
Installation and update flows offer sturdier safeguards when upgrading versions or maintaining isolated environments. ⟦Upgrading access controls for a building once meant the old gate was dismantled even when an empty package arrived or inspections failed, whereas replacement is now permitted only after verifying the new hardware.⟧ When running `grok update --force-reinstall` or targeting the installed version on Linux and macOS, existing executables are retained if downloads fail their checks, rather than being deleted directly.

If a proxy or cache (temporary storage for computed or fetched results) returns an empty file, the installer keeps the original file instead of falsely reporting success.

Pressing `Ctrl+U` on the welcome screen to finish installation exits within the normal deadline, rather than hanging after displaying "Update installed".

When configuring a sandbox via settings or `--sandbox`, running `grok update` remains permitted in unconfined states; once confined in an isolated sandbox, Grok stops updating automatically and prompts you to run it manually instead.

items.original:
`grok update` still runs when `--sandbox` or config sets a sandbox profile, unless Grok is already running confined
Grok running confined in a sandbox never starts an update on its own and tells you to run `grok update` instead
Quitting to install an update with `Ctrl+U` on the welcome screen exits within the usual exit deadline instead of sometimes hanging after "Update installed"
`grok update --force-reinstall`, or `grok update --version` with the installed version, keeps your working `grok` on Linux and macOS when the download fails its checks, instead of deleting it
Installers keep the installed `grok` when a proxy or cache returns an empty download, instead of replacing it with an empty file and reporting success

title.zh-TW: Windows 替換檔案前驗證執行，修復舊版符號與編碼略過
title.en: Windows Verifies Execution Before Replacing Files, Fixing Legacy Symbols and Encoding Skips

body.zh-TW:
在 Windows 環境下安裝與操作時，多項系統相容性問題已獲得排解。Windows 安裝程式在替換 `grok.exe` 與 `agent.exe` 之前，會先驗證下載檔案能否正常執行；若下載內容有誤（如代理伺服器傳回封鎖頁面），會完整保留現有檔案。

在傳統的 `cmd.exe` 或 Windows PowerShell 主控台（console，命令列視窗）中，工作流程、儀表板、意見回饋與擴充套件對話框的狀態圖示與箭頭，會改以 `>`、`•`、`√` 或 `x` 顯示，不再呈現為空白方框。

部分 Windows 編輯器存檔時會附帶 UTF-8 位元組順序記號，現在含有此標記的自訂代理檔案都能正常載入，不再被直接略過。

當啟動出錯、切換 `/minimal` 或 `/fullscreen`，或是收到終止訊號時，Grok 會徹底退出，不再偶爾掛起。
body.en:
Multiple system compatibility issues have been resolved when installing and operating on Windows. Before replacing `grok.exe` and `agent.exe`, the Windows installer verifies that the downloaded build runs properly. If the download is invalid (such as when a proxy returns a blocked page), it keeps existing files intact.

On legacy consoles (command-line windows) such as `cmd.exe` and Windows PowerShell, status icons and selection arrows in workflow views, dashboards, feedback dialogs, and extensions dialogs now display as `>`, `•`, `√`, or `x` instead of empty boxes.

Some Windows editors save files with a UTF-8 byte order mark. Custom agent files containing this mark now load normally instead of being skipped.

Grok exits cleanly instead of occasionally hanging after startup errors, switching with `/minimal` or `/fullscreen`, or receiving termination signals.

items.original:
Windows: Grok exits fully after a startup error, a `/minimal` or `/fullscreen` switch, or a signal, instead of sometimes hanging
Windows installers check that the downloaded build runs before replacing `grok.exe` and `agent.exe`, and keep the existing install when it does not, such as when a proxy serves a blocked-download page
Windows: on older consoles such as plain `cmd.exe` and Windows PowerShell windows, status marks and selection arrows in workflow views, the dashboard, and the feedback and extensions dialogs show as `>`, `•`, `√` or `x` instead of empty boxes
Custom agent files saved with a UTF-8 byte order mark, as some Windows editors write them, load instead of being skipped

title.zh-TW: 命令列非 UTF-8 引數容錯啟動，無頭模式中止輸出結尾紀錄
title.en: Non-UTF-8 Command-Line Arguments Tolerated at Startup, and Headless Termination Adds Closing Record

body.zh-TW:
在自動化腳本或特殊系統編碼環境中執行時，啟動與非正常中斷的處置具備了完整防護。傳入無效的非 UTF-8 命令列引數不再導致 Grok 在啟動時崩潰。例如 `--cwd` 這類路徑參數能正常接收，而 `-p` 等文字參數則會顯示用法錯誤提示，不再直接閃退。

系統環境變數中若含有非 UTF-8 位元組，現在也不會再阻礙 Grok 正常啟動。

在無頭模式（headless，沒有終端機視窗／視覺介面的執行模式）下執行時，若被 Ctrl-C 或 SIGTERM 訊號中止，`json`、`streaming-json` 或 `streaming-messages-json` 串流會補上一筆結尾紀錄保留成果，不再直接中斷。
body.en:
Startup and abnormal termination handling are now fully protected when running in automation scripts or environments with specialized system encodings. Passing invalid non-UTF-8 command-line arguments no longer crashes Grok at startup. Path arguments such as `--cwd` are accepted properly, while text arguments such as `-p` display usage error messages instead of crashing instantly.

System environment variables containing non-UTF-8 bytes also no longer prevent Grok from starting normally.

When running in headless mode (an execution mode without a terminal window or visual interface), runs stopped by Ctrl-C or SIGTERM signals end their `json`, `streaming-json`, or `streaming-messages-json` streams with a closing record that preserves the run outcome, instead of cutting off abruptly.

items.original:
Command-line arguments that are not valid UTF-8 no longer crash `grok` at startup: paths such as `--cwd` accept them, and text such as `-p` gets a usage error
Environment variables with non-UTF-8 bytes no longer stop Grok from starting
Headless runs stopped by Ctrl-C or SIGTERM end their `json`, `streaming-json` or `streaming-messages-json` output with a closing record that keeps the run's outcome, instead of cutting off the stream

title.zh-TW: 修復單行長文字貼上凍結，解決打字延遲與沙盒卡死
title.en: Fix Freezes on Long Single-Line Pastes, Resolve Typing Lag and Sandbox Hangs

body.zh-TW:
在終端機輸入提示詞或貼上大量資料時，介面卡頓與凍結問題已經修復。將日誌、JSON 或 base64 等超長單行文字貼入提示框時，終端介面不再凍結數秒。

在原生 Windows 或不支援括號貼上的終端機中，貼上內容常轉為連續按鍵輸入；在開啟規劃模式提示時，這類長貼上不再導致輸入框卡住數秒。

當未安裝 ffmpeg 且 `PATH` 包含較慢的目錄時（例如 WSL 環境下的 Windows 磁碟機），打字不再延遲。

在 macOS 上，當終端介面在阻擋視窗伺服器的沙盒中執行時，介面也不再陷入凍結。
body.en:
When entering prompts or pasting large amounts of data in the terminal, interface stutter and freeze issues have been resolved. Pasting very long single-line text such as logs, JSON, or base64 into the prompt box no longer freezes the terminal interface for seconds.

On native Windows or in terminals without bracketed paste support, pasted content often arrives as a sequence of keystrokes. When the plan-mode tip is enabled, these long pastes no longer cause the prompt box to freeze for seconds.

Typing no longer lags when ffmpeg is not installed and `PATH` contains slow directories (such as Windows drives under WSL).

On macOS, when the terminal interface runs inside a sandbox that blocks the window server, the UI no longer freezes.

items.original:
macOS: the TUI no longer freezes when it runs inside a sandbox that blocks the window server
Typing no longer lags when ffmpeg is not installed and `PATH` holds slow directories, such as Windows drives under WSL
Long pastes that arrive as keystrokes, such as pastes on native Windows or in terminals without bracketed paste, no longer freeze the prompt for seconds while the plan-mode tip is on
Pasting long single-line text such as logs, JSON or base64 into the prompt no longer freezes the TUI for seconds

title.zh-TW: 長對話自動釋放排版記憶體，降低檔案監控與重繪 CPU 負擔
title.en: Release Layout Memory in Long Sessions, Reduce CPU Load from File Watching and Repaints

body.zh-TW:
處理大型專案或展開長篇對話時，記憶體與處理器資源的消耗得到有效控制。在長時間工作階段中，已經滾動到螢幕遠方的已完成 Markdown 區塊會主動釋放渲染好的排版版面，有效減少記憶體佔用；當你搜尋歷史訊息時，文字搜尋依然能順利找到它們。

在 Linux 系統的大型程式碼庫中，檔案監控功能修復了啟動後持續佔用單一 CPU 核心約一分鐘的問題。

當子代理在背景運作時，終端介面現在只針對畫面上的即時動畫進行重繪，減少子代理運作時的 CPU 消耗。
body.en:
When handling large projects or holding long conversations, memory and processor resource usage are kept under control. In long sessions, finished Markdown blocks that have scrolled far off screen proactively release their rendered layouts, effectively reducing memory usage. When you search message history, text search still finds them smoothly.

In large repositories on Linux, file watching fixes an issue where a single CPU core remained busy for about a minute after startup.

When subagents run in the background, the terminal interface now repaints only for on-screen animations, reducing CPU consumption while subagents are active.

items.original:
Long sessions use less memory: finished Markdown blocks far off screen release their rendered layout, and search still finds their text
File watching on Linux no longer keeps a CPU core busy for about a minute after startup in large repositories
Lower CPU use while subagents run: the TUI repaints only for animations on screen

title.zh-TW: 補齊對話框省略符號，統一狀態燈號與搜尋醒目色彩
title.en: Add Dialog Ellipsis Marks, Unify Status Indicators and Search Highlight Colors

body.zh-TW:
在終端介面瀏覽各項面板、設定對話框與狀態提示時，畫面呈現更加精準一致。意見回饋若送出失敗，訊息會優先說明處理結果，隨後列出失敗原因並引導輸入 `/feedback` 重新發送。

當對話框的分頁標籤、快捷鍵說明或設定列超出寬度時，結尾會以 `…` 省略號收尾，不再直接被硬生生截斷。

搜尋提示詞歷史紀錄時，相符字母會以一致的顏色醒目標示，`/` 與 `@` 選單邊框計數也同步淡化。

儀表板在串流回覆時標頭會顯示 `Responding`，頁尾按鍵提示維持全小寫規範的 `new agent`。

工作流程標記與啟動中的 MCP 伺服器皆套用主題執行中色彩；精簡模式下登入失敗訊息也改以錯誤顏色顯示。
body.en:
Browsing panels, settings dialogs, and status prompts in the terminal interface now provides a more precise and consistent visual presentation. If feedback fails to send, the message leads with the outcome, then lists the failure reason and guides you to enter `/feedback` to retry.

When dialog tab labels, shortcut descriptions, or settings rows exceed their width, they end in an ellipsis `…` instead of being abruptly cut off.

When searching prompt history, matching letters are highlighted in a consistent color, and the counts on the `/` and `@` menu borders are dimmed as well.

While a reply streams, the dashboard peek header displays `Responding`, and the footer key hint keeps the all-lowercase convention of `new agent`.

Running markers in workflow views and starting MCP servers both use the theme's running color. In minimal mode, "Sign-in failed" messages also appear in the error color.

items.original:
Feedback that cannot be sent leads with the outcome, such as "Could not send feedback. Saved to Drafts.", then gives the reason and says to retry from `/feedback`
Dialog tab labels, shortcuts and settings rows that do not fit end in `…` instead of being cut off
Prompt history search highlights matched letters in the same color as other fuzzy lists, and the counts on the `/` and `@` menu borders are dimmed like other border captions
Dashboard: the peek header reads `Responding` while a reply streams, and the `Esc` footer hint reads `new agent` like the other lowercase hints
Running markers in workflow views and MCP servers that are still starting use the theme's running color, like other progress indicators
Minimal mode: "Sign-in failed" shows in the error color instead of the warning color

entries: `Page Up`/`Page Down`, `Home` and `End` move the selection in `/skills` and other pickers
Automatic updates stop retrying a new version that fails to start on this machine until a newer version is out, and each launch says to run `grok update` to see why
Gruvbox dark theme (`gruvbox-dark-hard`), selectable with `/theme`
Start in multiline in `/settings` (`[ui] multiline_default`) starts new sessions and the dashboard in multiline mode, where `Enter` inserts a newline
Windows: quitting Grok ends `grok.exe` once the terminal is restored, so the shell no longer sometimes waits with no prompt
Several Send nows in a row no longer label the turns they stop "Turn cancelled by user" or jump the transcript view
`--restore-code`: when the code restore fails, your uncommitted and untracked files stay in the working tree instead of in a stash
Windows: shortcuts typed with `Shift`-held symbols or AZERTY digit keys work
Queued images show as green chips in the queue pane, as in the prompt
Typing while the transcript has focus moves any character, including non-ASCII text, to the prompt, and leaves a pending card or plan approval as it is
Worktree creation notes stay on screen when a queued prompt starts
Session load errors show the whole reason instead of cutting out the middle of a long message
Lines with `|` that are not a Markdown table wrap like other text instead of being cut off at the terminal edge
Transcript selection stays on the same row when a row above it is removed
Kitty graphics protocol: images Grok hides are freed in the terminal, so they no longer use its memory
`--restore-code` restores its own stash even when another worktree changes the stash list meanwhile, and keeps your changes stashed when a post-checkout hook fails after the checkout

title.zh-TW: 自動更新遇啟動失敗即停止重試，提示執行 grok update
title.en: Automatic updates stop retrying after launch failures and prompt to run grok update

body.zh-TW: 如果新下載的版本在你的電腦上啟動失敗，過往開啟工具時容易被卡在重複嘗試的流程中。以前即使新版本在當前環境有重大問題而無法開啟，自動更新依然會在每次啟動時不斷嘗試套用，反覆遭遇啟動挫折。⟦宛如社區管線檢測發現閥門故障時立刻掛上維修警示，在原廠送達新零件前不再反覆送電硬推，改請住戶手動查看檢驗單。⟧現在只要新版本在本機啟動失敗，自動更新便會停止重試，直到官方發布更新的版本為止。每次啟動時終端機都會明確提示你執行 `grok update` 查明失敗原因。
body.en: If a newly downloaded version fails to start on your computer, launching the tool previously risked trapping you in repeated attempts. Automatic updates used to persistently attempt to apply a new version at every launch even when major issues in the current environment prevented it from opening, running into repeated startup frustration. ⟦Picture a community pipeline inspection hanging a maintenance warning the moment a valve fails: instead of repeatedly forcing power through before replacement parts arrive from the factory, it asks residents to check the inspection slip manually.⟧ Now, as long as a new version fails to launch on this machine, automatic updates stop retrying until an even newer version is officially released. Every time you launch, the terminal clearly prompts you to run `grok update` to see why it failed.

items.original: Automatic updates stop retrying a new version that fails to start on this machine until a newer version is out, and each launch says to run `grok update` to see why

title.zh-TW: 設定支援預設多行模式，按 Enter 直接換行不搶送出
title.en: Settings add default multiline mode so pressing Enter inserts a newline without sending

body.zh-TW: 每次撰寫長篇提示詞時，最怕才按一下換行鍵就把尚未完成的半成品直接送了出去。⟦恰似在多功能筆記本裡切換書寫格式，以前每次翻開新頁面都預設是便條紙，隨手敲一下就撕下送出；現在把格式固定為長文信紙，按下按鍵只是順暢跳到下一行繼續落筆。⟧現在你在 `/settings` 啟用 `Start in multiline` 選項，或是在設定檔的 `[ui]` 區段加入 `multiline_default` 設定，未來開啟新工作階段（session，對話互動的獨立階段）與儀表板時，都會預設進入多行模式。在這個模式下，按下 `Enter` 鍵只會插入換行符號。
body.en: When composing long prompts, nothing is more frustrating than pressing the newline key only to accidentally send an unfinished draft. ⟦Think of switching writing formats in a multi-purpose notebook: opening a new page previously defaulted to sticky notes where a single tap tore it off and sent it away, but now the format is locked to stationery paper so pressing a key smoothly advances to the next line to keep writing.⟧ When you enable the `Start in multiline` option in `/settings` or add the `multiline_default` setting under the `[ui]` section in your configuration file, launching new sessions (independent stages of conversational interaction) and the dashboard will now enter multiline mode by default. In this mode, pressing `Enter` only inserts a newline.

items.original: Start in multiline in `/settings` (`[ui] multiline_default`) starts new sessions and the dashboard in multiline mode, where `Enter` inserts a newline

title.zh-TW: 挑選器支援快速鍵翻頁跳轉，新增 Gruvbox 深色主題
title.en: Pickers support paging shortcuts and introduce the Gruvbox dark theme

body.zh-TW: 翻閱長度驚人的功能清單或挑選器時，光靠上下方向鍵一步步挪動往往相當耗時。⟦好比在圖書館的密集書庫查閱目錄，以前遇上厚厚的索引本只能單頁逐行翻找，現在既能按分頁鍵整段跳頁或直達卷首卷尾，書架還換上了護眼的暖色系陳列。⟧現在於 `/skills` 與各類挑選器（pickers，彈出式選項清單）中，你可以直接使用 `Page Up` 與 `Page Down` 上下翻頁，或是按下 `Home` 與 `End` 鍵直接跳到首項或末項。輸入 `/theme` 切換外觀時，清單內也新增了 `gruvbox-dark-hard` 復古高對比深色主題供你選用。
body.en: Scrolling through extensive feature lists or pickers using only the up and down arrow keys to move step by step can often take considerable time. ⟦Imagine searching a catalog in dense library stacks: where a thick index previously required flipping page by page and line by line, you can now jump full pages or skip straight to the beginning or end, and the shelves even feature an eye-friendly warm color scheme.⟧ In `/skills` and various pickers (pop-up option lists), you can now use `Page Up` and `Page Down` to flip pages up and down, or press `Home` and `End` to jump directly to the first or last entry. When entering `/theme` to switch appearances, the list also adds a retro high-contrast `gruvbox-dark-hard` dark theme for you to choose.

items.original:
`Page Up`/`Page Down`, `Home` and `End` move the selection in `/skills` and other pickers
Gruvbox dark theme (`gruvbox-dark-hard`), selectable with `/theme`

title.zh-TW: `--restore-code` 遇失敗保留工作區檔案，精準鎖定專屬儲藏
title.en: `--restore-code` keeps workspace files on failure and targets its own stash

body.zh-TW: 執行程式碼還原若中途出錯，工作區裡尚未提交與未追蹤的檔案最需要得到妥善保留。⟦猶如維修師傅整理零件抽屜，以前只要零件卡榫安裝失敗，隨手擱在桌上的散裝零件就會被整批掃進雜物箱；現在桌面的散件原封不動，抽屜也加了專屬標籤，就算隔壁工作檯重新調動工具箱也不會拿錯。⟧使用 `--restore-code` 還原程式碼時，若還原過程失敗，你尚未提交與未追蹤的檔案現在會穩妥保留在工作樹（Git 讓同一專案平行開多份副本的功能）中，不會被收進儲藏。即使其他平行工作區在此期間更動了儲藏（stash，Git 暫時收起未提交修改的功能）清單，`--restore-code` 也能精準辨識並還原專屬於自己的儲藏紀錄。若切換分支後執行的結帳後掛鉤（post-checkout hook，切換分支後自動觸發的小程式）發生錯誤，你的修改也會安全保留在儲藏內。
body.en: When an error occurs during code restoration, uncommitted and untracked files in the workspace need proper preservation above all. ⟦Consider a mechanic organizing a parts drawer: if a latch failed to install, loose pieces left on the workbench used to be swept wholesale into a junk bin, but now the workbench pieces stay untouched and the drawer gets a dedicated tag so rearranging toolboxes at an adjacent bench will not mix them up.⟧ When restoring code with `--restore-code`, if the restoration process fails, your uncommitted and untracked files now safely remain in the working tree (Git's feature for opening multiple parallel copies of the same project) instead of being stashed. Even if other parallel workspaces modify the stash (Git's feature for temporarily shelving uncommitted changes) list in the meantime, `--restore-code` accurately identifies and restores its own dedicated stash record. If a post-checkout hook (a small program automatically triggered after switching branches) fails after the checkout, your changes will also remain safely stashed.

items.original:
`--restore-code`: when the code restore fails, your uncommitted and untracked files stay in the working tree instead of in a stash
`--restore-code` restores its own stash even when another worktree changes the stash list meanwhile, and keeps your changes stashed when a post-checkout hook fails after the checkout

title.zh-TW: Windows 退出徹底結束處理程序，修復 Shift 與 AZERTY 快捷鍵
title.en: Windows exits end processes cleanly and fix Shift and AZERTY shortcuts

body.zh-TW: 在 Windows 平台使用命令列時，關閉軟體或輸入特殊組合鍵容易遇到卡頓與無回應的狀況。以前在命令列退出 Grok 時，雖然視窗畫面已復原，但背景中的 `grok.exe` 處理程序有時並未結束，導致命令列停留在無提示字元的等待狀態。⟦像借用會議室開完會，以前雖然關了燈，投影機卻還卡在運轉而無法交還場地，現在離開時會連同所有設備徹底關閉。⟧現在只要終端機畫面完成復原，`grok.exe` 就會立刻結束執行，將控制權正常交還給終端機。在鍵盤操作上，以前按住 `Shift` 鍵輸入的符號快捷鍵，或是 AZERTY 鍵盤上的數字鍵快捷鍵經常無法觸發，現在這些按鍵組合在 Windows 上都能正常識別運作。
body.en: When using the command line on Windows, closing the application or entering special key combinations could easily encounter stalls and unresponsiveness. Previously, when quitting Grok from the command line, even though the terminal window was restored, the background `grok.exe` process sometimes failed to end, leaving the shell waiting without a prompt. ⟦Like leaving a borrowed conference room after a meeting: turning off the lights previously left the projector running so the room could not be handed back, but now departing shuts down every piece of equipment completely.⟧ Now, as soon as the terminal screen finishes restoring, `grok.exe` terminates immediately to return control properly to the shell. For keyboard input, shortcuts typed with `Shift`-held symbols or AZERTY digit keys often failed to trigger, but these key combinations are now recognized and function normally on Windows.

items.original:
Windows: quitting Grok ends `grok.exe` once the terminal is restored, so the shell no longer sometimes waits with no prompt
Windows: shortcuts typed with `Shift`-held symbols or AZERTY digit keys work

title.zh-TW: 佇列面板顯示排隊圖片標籤，連續立即發送不誤標取消
title.en: Queue pane displays queued image chips and successive Send nows avoid false cancellation labels

body.zh-TW:
面對排入佇列的大量提示詞，若想連續插隊執行，介面狀態與終端機畫面現在銜接得更加穩定。⟦就像在得來速車道連續調整點單順序，以前服務鈴一催促，原本進行中的餐點會被廣播誤報為顧客退訂，監視螢幕還會晃動；現在換單順暢銜接，取餐螢幕清楚標示附餐圖示，施工指引也一直留在看板上。⟧

在佇列面板中，排隊等待處理的圖片現在會與輸入框一致，顯示為綠色標籤晶片（chips），方便辨識隨附的圖檔。

當佇列中的提示詞開始執行時，建立工作樹（Git 讓同一專案平行開多份副本的功能）的提示訊息會持續保留在螢幕上，不會被新啟動的任務清空。

連續多次點擊「立即發送」插隊時，被中途停止的輪次不再被標示為使用者取消，對話紀錄檢視畫面也不會突然跳動。
body.en:
When managing many queued prompts and jumping the queue repeatedly, the interface state and terminal display now stay much more stable. ⟦A drive-thru lane smoothly adjusts orders in succession: whenever an intercom chime previously rushed the queue, an in-progress meal would be mistakenly announced as cancelled by the customer while the monitoring screen jittered, but order swaps now transition cleanly, pickup screens clearly display side-item icons, and construction signs stay right on the board.⟧

In the queue pane, queued images waiting to be processed now appear as green chips, matching the prompt input box, making it easy to identify attached image files.

When a queued prompt starts executing, notes about creating a working tree (Git's feature for opening multiple parallel copies of the same project) stay on screen instead of being cleared by newly launched tasks.

When clicking "Send now" several times in a row to jump the queue, stopped turns are no longer labeled "Turn cancelled by user", and the transcript view no longer jumps abruptly.

items.original:
Several Send nows in a row no longer label the turns they stop "Turn cancelled by user" or jump the transcript view
Queued images show as green chips in the queue pane, as in the prompt
Worktree creation notes stay on screen when a queued prompt starts

title.zh-TW: 對話檢視支援輸入自動轉向，完善折行排版並釋放圖片快取
title.en: Transcript view redirects typed input, refines line wrapping, and frees image caches

body.zh-TW:
瀏覽過往的對話紀錄與執行過程時，游標選取、文字折行與終端機的資源釋放細節已修復完備。

當焦點停在對話紀錄時，鍵入任何文字（包含非 ASCII 的中文字元）都會直接導向提示詞輸入框，且不會影響等待審核的卡片或計畫。

載入工作階段（session，對話互動的獨立階段）若發生錯誤，終端機會顯示完整原因，不再把過長訊息的中間段落截斷省略。

內含豎線 `|` 但非 Markdown 表格的文字行，現在會像一般文字正常折行，不再於終端機邊緣被硬生生切斷。

在對話紀錄中選取文字時，即使上方有項目被移除，選取的游標列仍會穩定停留在同一列。

採用 Kitty 圖像協定的終端機，在 Grok 隱藏圖片後會立即釋放終端機內的影像記憶體，不再持續佔用快取空間。
body.en:
When browsing past transcripts and execution history, cursor selection, text wrapping, and terminal resource cleanup details have been thoroughly polished.

Typing any text while the transcript has focus (including non-ASCII Chinese characters) directs the input straight to the prompt, leaving any pending card or plan approval as it is.

When an error occurs loading a session (an independent stage of conversational interaction), the terminal shows the complete reason instead of cutting out the middle of a long message.

Lines containing a vertical bar `|` that are not a Markdown table now wrap like normal text instead of being cut off at the terminal edge.

When selecting text in the transcript, the selected row stays steadily on the same row even when an entry above it is removed.

For terminals using the Kitty graphics protocol, images Grok hides are freed immediately in the terminal, so they no longer consume cache memory.

items.original:
Typing while the transcript has focus moves any character, including non-ASCII text, to the prompt, and leaves a pending card or plan approval as it is
Session load errors show the whole reason instead of cutting out the middle of a long message
Lines with `|` that are not a Markdown table wrap like other text instead of being cut off at the terminal edge
Transcript selection stays on the same row when a row above it is removed
Kitty graphics protocol: images Grok hides are freed in the terminal, so they no longer use its memory

entries: Relative file paths in the agent's output, such as `src/app/main.rs`, open on click when the file exists under the session's folder, as absolute paths already do
Subagent and background task ids mentioned in the transcript open that subagent's view or the task's output on click
Pull-request numbers such as `#123` in the agent's replies open that pull request on the session repository's forge
Subagents named in a reply show as the subagent's label instead of its raw id once the reply finishes, as a link that opens its transcript
`/workflow runs` detail view: `→` or a click focuses a phase's agent list, `↑`/`↓` pick an agent, `Enter` opens it, and `←` returns to the phases
Feedback draft rows show on their own instead of inside a group of tool rows, and opening one shows the `/feedback` Drafts tab with that draft selected
Warp: clicking a URL that wraps across rows opens the whole URL instead of only its first row
`/delete` confirmation starts on Cancel, so pressing `Enter` no longer deletes the session; press `1` to delete
Max thoughts width (`/settings`, `[ui].max_thoughts_width`) sets how wide thinking blocks wrap; it previously had no effect
Dashboard shows the new folder on the dispatch box's top border right after a `Ctrl+L` or `/cd` pick
Custom models on the Responses API with a custom `base_url` no longer fail every turn with an HTTP 400 schema error for `use_tool`
`/feedback` Drafts tab keeps the selected draft when the list reloads, such as after leaving Drafts and coming back
MCP tools built with FastMCP or the official MCP SDK send their result to the model once instead of twice, so each call uses about half the context
Plan review notes accept every key, so a note that starts with `a` no longer approves the plan
MCP servers over stdio no longer lose part of a long reply line, such as a large tool list, when a read is interrupted

title.zh-TW: 對話輸出支援點擊跳轉，相對路徑與子代理標籤直達目標
title.en: Relative Paths and Subagent Labels Link Directly on Click

body.zh-TW: 翻閱終端機的對話紀錄時，經常需要查對助理提到的程式碼檔案或背景任務。⟦如同閱讀附帶豐富註腳的研究報告，以前讀到引用的附件名稱還得自己手動搜尋檔案路徑，現在只要滑鼠輕輕一點，就能直接翻開對應的文件頁面或作者備忘錄。⟧現在輸出中出現的相對檔案路徑，只要檔案位於目前工作階段的資料夾內，點擊就能直接開啟。紀錄裡提到的子代理（subagent，負責特定分工的輔助模型）與背景任務編號，點擊後也會直接切換到該檢視畫面或印出任務輸出。回覆中的 PR 編號點擊即可開啟遠端合併請求頁面。回覆完成後，文中提及的子代理更會換成好讀的標籤連結以開啟對話紀錄。在 Warp 終端機操作時，點擊折行的長網址也會開啟完整連結，不再只截取第一列。
body.en: When reviewing transcripts in the terminal, you often need to check code files or background tasks mentioned by the assistant. ⟦Reading through an annotated research report once meant manually searching for cited attachments; now a single click directly opens the referenced document page or author memo.⟧ Relative file paths in the output now open directly on click when the file exists under the current session folder. Clicking a subagent (auxiliary models handling specialized tasks) or background task ID mentioned in the transcript now switches to that subagent view or prints the task output. Clicking a pull request number in a reply opens the remote pull request page. Once a reply finishes, mentioned subagents are replaced with readable label links to open their transcripts. When working in Warp, clicking a URL that wraps across rows opens the full link instead of only its first row.

items.original:
Relative file paths in the agent's output, such as `src/app/main.rs`, open on click when the file exists under the session's folder, as absolute paths already do
Subagent and background task ids mentioned in the transcript open that subagent's view or the task's output on click
Pull-request numbers such as `#123` in the agent's replies open that pull request on the session repository's forge
Subagents named in a reply show as the subagent's label instead of its raw id once the reply finishes, as a link that opens its transcript
Warp: clicking a URL that wraps across rows opens the whole URL instead of only its first row

title.zh-TW: 工作流程檢視支援方向鍵導覽，快速穿梭階段與代理清單
title.en: Arrow-Key Navigation for Workflow Runs Between Phases and Agents

body.zh-TW: 推進多階段的自動化工作流程時，需要頻繁檢視各個執行環節中代理人的狀態。⟦好比用電視遙控器選取影集分季，按右鍵直接切入特定季度的集數選單，透過上下鍵挑選集數後按確認播放，按左鍵就能立刻退回季別目錄。⟧現在輸入 `/workflow runs` 進入詳細檢視畫面，可以完全透過鍵盤快速穿梭。按下向右鍵 `→` 或使用滑鼠點擊，能將焦點移至該階段的代理清單；按下向上鍵 `↑` 或向下鍵 `↓` 可選取特定代理，按下 `Enter` 就會開啟該代理；若想回到階段列表，只要按下向左鍵 `←` 即可返回。
body.en: When driving multi-phase automated workflows, you frequently need to check the status of agents across each stage. ⟦Picture using a TV remote to navigate seasons of a show: pressing right jumps into an episode list for a season, up and down pick an episode to play on confirmation, and pressing left returns to the season directory.⟧ Entering `/workflow runs` to open the detail view now allows full navigation purely from the keyboard. Pressing `→` or clicking with the mouse focuses a phase's agent list. Pressing `↑` or `↓` picks a specific agent, pressing `Enter` opens it, and pressing `←` returns to the phase list.

items.original: `/workflow runs` detail view: `→` or a click focuses a phase's agent list, `↑`/`↓` pick an agent, `Enter` opens it, and `←` returns to the phases

title.zh-TW: 回饋草稿獨立分列顯示，切換分頁重新整理維持選取
title.en: Feedback Drafts Stand Alone, Preserving Selection Across Tab Reloads

body.zh-TW: 準備向開發團隊回報問題時，暫存的草稿如果和其他工具訊息混在一起，往往不容易翻找。⟦就像辦公桌上的專用待辦便條夾，以前所有草稿跟一般工具雜物塞在同一個抽屜，切換工作視角再回頭時便條還會移位；現在草稿獨立陳列，即使離開再回來也能精準夾在原本選取的那一頁。⟧現在回饋草稿（feedback draft，尚未送出的意見回報）會單獨成列顯示，不再擠在工具列群組內部。點選開啟其中一筆時，會直接顯示 `/feedback` 的草稿分頁並鎖定該筆內容。當草稿清單重新載入時（例如離開分頁後再返回），先前選取的草稿狀態也會完整保留。
body.en: When preparing to report an issue to the development team, drafts mixed in with tool messages are often hard to locate. ⟦Think of a dedicated desk clip for to-do notes: loose drafts once mingled with miscellaneous tools inside a drawer and shifted when looking away, but now drafts stand on their own and stay clipped to the selected page even when you step away and return.⟧ Feedback drafts (unsent feedback reports) now appear on their own rows instead of being crowded inside a group of tool rows. Opening one immediately displays the `/feedback` Drafts tab with that entry selected. When the draft list reloads (such as after leaving the tab and returning), the previously selected draft state is also fully preserved.

items.original:
Feedback draft rows show on their own instead of inside a group of tool rows, and opening one shows the `/feedback` Drafts tab with that draft selected
`/feedback` Drafts tab keeps the selected draft when the list reloads, such as after leaving Drafts and coming back

title.zh-TW: 刪除確認預設移至取消，輸入審查備註不再誤觸核准
title.en: Delete Confirmation Defaults to Cancel, Preventing Accidental Plan Approvals

body.zh-TW: 在終端機執行清理或審查等重大操作時，最怕手指敲太快不小心按錯鍵而造成意外改動。⟦跟填寫重要申請書的勾選欄一樣，以前筆尖預設停在確認簽署，稍微晃動或碰到按鍵就可能直接送出；現在焦點預設停在取消欄位，必須明確按下特定按鍵才會執行。⟧現在執行 `/delete` 指令時，確認提示預設停留在「Cancel」（取消）選項。按下鍵盤的 `Enter` 不再直接刪除工作階段，讀者必須明確按下 `1` 才會執行刪除。在計畫審查中輸入說明備註時，輸入框已能正確接收每一個字元，輸入以英文字母 `a` 開頭的備註時，不會再誤將計畫直接核准。
body.en: When running major operations like cleanup or reviews in the terminal, accidental keystrokes can trigger unintended changes. ⟦A critical application form once placed your pen by default on the approval box where a slight slip could submit it; now focus rests on cancel, requiring an explicit keystroke to proceed.⟧ Running the `/delete` command now places confirmation on "Cancel" by default. Pressing `Enter` no longer deletes the session directly, requiring an explicit press of `1` to execute the deletion. When entering notes during plan review, the input field properly accepts every character. Typing a note that starts with `a` no longer mistakenly approves the plan.

items.original:
`/delete` confirmation starts on Cancel, so pressing `Enter` no longer deletes the session; press `1` to delete
Plan review notes accept every key, so a note that starts with `a` no longer approves the plan

title.zh-TW: 思考區塊支援自訂折行寬度，切換目錄即時更新派送框標籤
title.en: Custom Wrapping Width for Thinking Blocks and Instant Dispatch Box Label Updates

body.zh-TW: 面對終端機裡長篇的推導內文或切換目錄時，版面排版與即時狀態回饋對工作節奏影響甚大。⟦宛如翻閱電子書時自訂版面邊距與章節標頭，以前調整內文欄寬毫無反應，換到新章節時書名也慢半拍；現在既能自由約束文字寬度，切換篇章時頂部路徑標示也會即時更新。⟧在 `/settings` 設定中，`[ui].max_thoughts_width` 現在能正確控制思考區塊（thinking block，模型產生推理過程的文字框）的折行寬度上限，解決了先前設定後完全無效的問題。在儀表板畫面中，只要按下快捷鍵 `Ctrl+L` 或透過 `/cd` 選取新的資料夾，派送框（dispatch box）上邊框就會立刻顯示最新資料夾名稱，無需等待後續動作刷新。
body.en: Facing long reasoning output or switching directories in the terminal, layout structure and instant state feedback heavily influence your workflow rhythm. ⟦Adjusting margins and chapter headers in an e-reader once produced no response when changing column widths while header titles lagged behind; now text width conforms reliably and top navigation updates instantly when switching sections.⟧ In `/settings`, `[ui].max_thoughts_width` now properly controls the maximum wrapping width for thinking blocks (text boxes displaying model reasoning steps), resolving an issue where the setting previously had no effect. In the dashboard, pressing `Ctrl+L` or picking a new folder with `/cd` immediately displays the latest folder name on the top border of the dispatch box without waiting for subsequent actions to refresh.

items.original:
Max thoughts width (`/settings`, `[ui].max_thoughts_width`) sets how wide thinking blocks wrap; it previously had no effect
Dashboard shows the new folder on the dispatch box's top border right after a `Ctrl+L` or `/cd` pick

title.zh-TW: 自訂端點模型修復工具綱要錯誤，每輪不再跳出 HTTP 400
title.en: Custom Endpoint Models Fix Tool Schema Errors, Eliminating HTTP 400 Failures

body.zh-TW: 串接外部伺服器端點使用自訂模型時，每當模型試圖呼叫工具，最怕通訊協議格式對不上。⟦恰似拿轉接頭連接非原廠周邊設備，以前插頭上的接腳規範只要有一點出入，每次啟動設備就會直接跳電報警；現在通訊綱要規格完全符合標準，連線後每輪工具調用都能順暢進行。⟧透過 Responses API 搭配自訂網址（`base_url`）使用自訂模型時，先前每一輪只要發起 `use_tool`，就會因為結構規範不符而觸發 HTTP 400 錯誤。這項問題已經修好，自訂端點模型在每輪對話調用工具時不再報錯中斷。
body.en: When connecting to external server endpoints to use custom models, mismatched protocol formats are a major hazard whenever a model tries to invoke tools. ⟦A third-party peripheral plugged into an adapter once tripped the breaker whenever pinout standards differed slightly; now communication schemas conform precisely, allowing smooth tool execution on every cycle.⟧ When using custom models on the Responses API with a custom URL (`base_url`), every turn calling `use_tool` previously failed with an HTTP 400 error due to schema mismatches. This issue has been fixed, and custom endpoint models no longer abort with errors when calling tools during each turn.

items.original: Custom models on the Responses API with a custom `base_url` no longer fail every turn with an HTTP 400 schema error for `use_tool`

title.zh-TW: MCP 工具呼叫節省一半上下文，修復標準輸入輸出長行截斷
title.en: MCP Tool Calls Halve Context Usage, Fixing Truncation on Stdio Long Lines

body.zh-TW: 替 AI 掛載外部工具來擴充能力時，工具回傳資料的長度與穩定度直接決定了整場對話的品質。⟦好似快遞站簽收包裹回執，以前每件貨品都會重複影印兩次塞滿存檔箱，傳輸遇上震盪時長清單還會被撕毀截斷；現在單次回報只附一份單據，即便中途讀取受干擾也不會遺失內容。⟧許多開發者會使用 FastMCP 或官方開發套件擴充功能。現在這類依據 MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）建置的工具，傳回結果給模型時只會傳送一次而非兩次，每次呼叫消耗的上下文空間直接減半。透過標準輸入輸出（stdio）運行的伺服器，若讀取流程中途遭到中斷，也不會再遺失長回覆列的一部分，面對龐大的工具清單也能完整接收。
body.en: When attaching external tools to expand AI capabilities, the length and stability of returned data directly determine conversation quality. ⟦Courier receipts at a delivery hub once filled archive bins by printing duplicates for every package while transit bumps ripped long manifests; now each report attaches a single slip, preserving contents even when reading encounters interruptions.⟧ Many developers use FastMCP or the official SDK to extend features. Tools built with MCP (Model Context Protocol, a protocol connecting AI to external tools) now return results to the model once instead of twice, cutting context usage by half per call. Servers running over stdio no longer lose part of a long reply line when a read is interrupted, ensuring large tool lists are received in full.

items.original:
MCP tools built with FastMCP or the official MCP SDK send their result to the model once instead of twice, so each call uses about half the context
MCP servers over stdio no longer lose part of a long reply line, such as a large tool list, when a read is interrupted
